notAnApproval: Generating or issuing a report, exporting it or submitting an owner update records facts; none of these is a business approval.
textLength: Enter between {{min}} and {{max}} characters of visible text.

reason.stale: (the latest value is out of date)

legend.unknown: no value, shown instead of a number;
legend.stale: the latest value is out of date, so no number is shown.

reports.title: Reports and snapshots
reports.intro: Generate each output from this transformation's records. A live preview is never stored; a generated snapshot is fixed and can be issued, exported or discarded.
reports.entryIntro: Generated reports and their issued, unchangeable snapshots. Reports belong to a transformation.

generate.title: Generate a report
generate.intro: Choose the output and what it reports on. Nothing is typed into a report: it is assembled from the records as they are now.
generate.noSubjects: There is nothing of this kind in this transformation yet.
generate.periodsUnavailable: The reporting periods could not be listed.
generate.allRows: All rows of the register, as its list shows them.
generate.readOnly: You can preview reports; generating a snapshot needs the report generation permission.
generate.liveNote: Live: assembled now from the current records and not stored. Generate a snapshot to keep it.

snapshots.title: Snapshots
snapshots.intro: Every generated, issued, superseded and discarded snapshot of this transformation, newest first. None is ever deleted.
snapshots.noneBody: Generate a report above to create the first snapshot.

snapshot.title: Report snapshot
snapshot.intro: The report as it was at its as-of time, with the record revisions, versions and evidence it was built from.
snapshot.draftBanner: Draft — not an issued report. Its content is fixed; issue it to make it the official report, or discard it.
snapshot.supersededBanner: Superseded on {{when}} by a later issue. Its content is unchanged.
snapshot.issueIntro: Issuing makes this snapshot the next official issue of its series. Its content does not change. Issuing is not an approval.
snapshot.discardIntro: A discarded snapshot is kept, never deleted, and cannot be exported.
snapshot.reissueIntro: Generates a new snapshot of the same output from the current records, in the same series. This issue stays unchanged until the reissue is issued.

retained.versionsIntro: The versions that shaped this report when it was generated.
retained.sourcesIntro: Each record used, at the revision it had at the as-of time.
retained.evidenceIntro: The evidence this report cites, with the revision and checksum it had then.

exports.title: Exports
exports.intro: Your export jobs, newest first. Every export is produced in the background, with progress; only you see your jobs.
exports.howTo: To export, open a report snapshot and choose a format and a language.
exports.noneBody: Exports you start from a report snapshot appear here.
exports.newIntro: Produce a file of this snapshot in one of the formats this output offers, in English or Arabic.
exports.draftNote: This snapshot is not issued: the file will be marked “Draft — not an issued report”.
exports.readOnly: Exporting needs the export permission in this transformation.
exports.discarded: A discarded snapshot cannot be exported.

presentation.title: Presentation mode
presentation.entryIntro: Present a meeting's pack, live or as an issued snapshot. Meetings belong to a transformation.
presentation.noMeetings: This transformation has no meetings yet.
presentation.intro: The meeting pack, read-only: its agenda items with their linked decisions, asks and actions.
presentation.liveNote: Live: assembled now from the current records. A linked decision changed before cut-off appears changed here.
presentation.snapshotNote: A pack snapshot: its stored content, unchanged whatever has changed since.
presentation.openPack: Open the pack (issue, export PDF or PPTX)
presentation.printableIntro: The printable pack is a meeting-pack snapshot: generate it, issue it, then export it as PDF or PPTX.

updates.title: Owner updates
updates.entryIntro: Structured period updates from owners that feed the executive pack. Updates belong to a transformation.
updates.intro: One structured update per reporting period for the transformation and each workstream, written by its owner.
updates.packNote: The executive pack prints each submitted update verbatim next to the workstream's current metrics; a workstream without one shows “No update submitted”.
updates.noPeriodsBody: Updates are written per reporting period; none is defined yet.
updates.periodNotOpen: This period is not open: its updates can be read but not written.
updates.noOwner: No owner: this workstream has no lead.
updates.draftBanner: Saved draft — not submitted. The executive pack does not use it until it is submitted.
updates.noUpdate: No update has been written for this period.
updates.saveHint: Save keeps a draft. Submit makes it the update of this period; at least one field must be written.

evidence.title: Evidence register
evidence.entryIntro: Every evidence item with its linked records, type, source, owner, observation period, upload date, version, checksum and review status. Evidence belongs to a transformation.
evidence.intro: Every evidence item of this transformation with its linkage, version and checksum. A new upload of a file becomes its next version.
evidence.uploadHint: Evidence is added and uploaded on the evidence screen.
evidence.noneBody: Evidence added to this transformation appears here.
